title: Podcast Ads for Beginners | Spotify Advertising

facts.fact: The average person uses 6.7 social media platforms per month, according to Spotify's guide.
facts.quote: the average person now using 6.7 social media platforms per month and 66% of people second-screening.

facts.fact: According to Spotify citing a second-party source, 71% of daily podcast users say podcast content gets all or most of their attention.
facts.quote: 71% of daily podcast users say podcast content gets all or most of their attention

facts.fact: According to Spotify, 90% of Gen Zs say they often or sometimes feel fully present in the moment while listening to podcasts and music during everyday activities.
facts.quote: 90% of Gen Zs say they often or sometimes feel fully present in the moment while listening to podcasts and music during everyday activities

facts.fact: According to Spotify, 59% of Spotify podcast listeners say they feel more connected to podcast hosts than to social media influencers.
facts.quote: 59% of Spotify podcast listeners say they feel more connected to podcast hosts than social media influencers

facts.fact: According to a 2024 KS&R report cited by Spotify, more than a third of Millennials listen to podcasts daily.
facts.quote: Millennials are all in, too, with more than a third listening to podcasts daily, according to a 2024 KS&R report.

facts.fact: According to EMARKETER as cited by Spotify, 504.9 million people worldwide listened to podcasts in 2024.
facts.quote: as 504.9 million people worldwide did in 2024, according to EMARKETER

facts.fact: Spotify states it reaches over 115 million monthly podcast listeners in the U.S. alone.
facts.quote: We reach over 115 million monthly podcast listeners in the U.S. alone

facts.fact: Spotify states that more than 90% of all U.S. podcast listeners tune in through its network, whether on Spotify or another app.
facts.quote: with +90% of all U.S. podcast listeners tuning in through our network

facts.fact: Spotify reports that 42% of Spotify podcast listeners it surveyed trust their favourite podcast host(s) as much as their friends.
facts.quote: 42% of Spotify podcast listeners we asked trust their favourite podcast host(s) as much as they trust their friends.

facts.fact: Spotify claims adding podcasts to a Spotify Ads Manager media mix delivers 96% unique audience reach.
facts.quote: 96% Unique audience reach by adding podcasts to your Spotify Ads Manager media mix.

facts.fact: Spotify states that Ads Manager offers transparent, fixed CPM pricing for podcast ads, giving advertisers full control over spend.
facts.quote: You can maintain full control over spend with transparent, fixed CPM pricing, so budgeting is easier and more efficient.

facts.fact: Spotify states that podcast inventory bought programmatically through the Spotify Ad Exchange can be accessed via DSPs including The Trade Desk, Google Display & Video 360, Amazon DSP, and Yahoo DSP through Private Marketplace deals.
facts.quote: This enables Private Marketplace (PMP) deals via DSPs such as The Trade Desk, Google Display & Video 360, Amazon DSP, and Yahoo DSP.
